items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He said, play on that banjo you got there. He said, I can play, Mr. Tarnes.

ctx.x: Okay, go ahead. Ask them about the tranchina.

Oh, the tranchina. Yeah, after they played there a while, the tranchina, they kept on, so they turned to the boys and they said, Dad can't play no banjo like this, Dad can't play no banjo like that. And, um, always banging on the set. So, at the time, they got rid of the band. They told tranchina, say, my boy, what do you call yourself doing? I said, what, Mr. Tarnes? He said, play on that banjo you got there. He said, I can play, Mr. Tarnes. He said, you can't play nothing. He said, give me that banjo. And…
Ask him about Tony Jackson. He wanted to tell us about Tony Jackson.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: after we played two tunes, he said he'd come sit by me, just like he'd sit by me.

ctx.x: And ask him if you ever worked with the Young Morgan Band.

Have you ever worked with the Young Morgan Band? Yeah, yeah. Let me see. Isaiah Martin. Yeah, I used to work with him. He played his band. He played for me. He was playing out at Spanish Post. And you know, old man, Transcena, he could play music too. Transcena, that's the fella who used to run the place out there, you know. You know what I was talking about? Transcena? That was the boss, you know, who used to run that, you know, that place out there. But anyhow, he was a great bass fella. He didn't sit in the…
When did you start using ninths? Who? When did you start using- Using ninths?
